title: Autonomy Register — Section F: Human Oversight
description: Section F of the Autonomy Register entry, as specified in STD-EDS-007.

oversight_model.description: Values: HITL │ HOTL │ HAL. Must match the MDAM entry for the operational domain. (Source of truth: CAIO)

primary_hotl_supervisor.description: [Mandatory for Level 3+] cert_ref must reference a valid FRM-EDS-003 certification record. cert_expiry must be a future date. Null for Level 1–2 systems. (Source of truth: CAIO)

backup_hotl_supervisors.description: [Mandatory for Level 3+] Minimum one backup required at Level 3+. Minimum two at Level 4+. Null for Level 1–2. (Source of truth: CAIO)

hotl_coverage_hours.description: [Mandatory for Level 3+] Format: 24x7 │ Business_hours_HH:MM-HH:MM_AEST │ Custom:[description]. Must specify named coverage periods. (Source of truth: CAIO)

killswitch_operators.description: Minimum one for Level 1–2. Minimum two for Level 3. Minimum three for Level 4+. Training date must be within 12 months. (Source of truth: CAIO / CTO)

killswitch_last_tested.description: Level 3: within 90 days. Level 4–5: within 30 days. Triggers non-compliance flag if overdue. (Source of truth: CTO)

killswitch_next_test_due.description: Computed from killswitch_last_tested + testing frequency per autonomy_level. (Source of truth: System — computed)
